Ali Akber (Md) ------ Petitioner
Vs.

full_judgment: 3. Defendants Nos. 1 to 6 and 9 to 11 contested the suit by filing a written statement denying all the material allegations made in the plaint. They contended, inter aria, that the petitioner has no cause of action. The owners of the suit land in CS record are Zinnat Ali, Ashrab Ali, Hossain Ali, Rowsan Ali and the said land was recorded in the name of Zinnat Ali as he is the owner and possessor of the land as mentioned in the comment column and on the death of Zinnat Ali, his heirs were Syban Bibi and Rabbani Bibi. Syban Bibi died leaving behind her two sons, Sattar Mia and Nuru Mia, who are enjoying the suit land and sold 30 decimals land to Sukkur Ali on 9-8-1950 vide registered sale deed No. 3698, and delivered possession and said Sukkur Ali's name was recorded in SA and RS record with others and on 4-11-1970 Sukkur Ali transferred 96 decimals land to his son Akbar Ali and delivered possession and on the same day, 5.20 decimals land was transferred to Anwar Hossain and the plaintiff sold 4.50 decimals land on 2-8-1998 to Zahurul Haq and handed over possession by virtue of Bonton Nama deed which was executed on 27-11-1995 and thereafter, the plaintiff also sold 4.50 decimals land on 9-3-1997 to Abdur Rashid and his wife, 11.50 decimals land was sold in dag No. 127 on 18.4-1996 to Abdus Salam, 7.50 decimals land was sold to Shofiqul Islam on 3-7-1996 which was corrected vide deed dated 24-10-2004 in favour of Rashid Mondol and thus the partition deed having been acted upon, the suit is liable to be dismissed.
